9. Durante la semana pasada, ¿cuánto tiempo dedicó... a

quotes.location: Section IX. OTRAS ACTIVIDADES, Question 9, option 7

assessments.reasoning: The instrument captures main work in Section III (Question 3) and secondary work in Section VII (Question 7). Independently of these, Section IX (Question 9, option 7) records the time spent by each respondent on domestic work ("realizar los quehaceres de su hogar?"). Because domestic work and care activities are captured in dedicated individual questions recording time spent separately from employment questions, main work, secondary work, and domestic work can be distinguished for each person.
